tools.name: moxie_list_clients
tools.description: List active clients in the workspace with their contacts, address, tax and billing details. Moxie API: GET /clients/list.

tools.name: moxie_search_clients
tools.description: Find active clients by an exact id, or by free text matched on the client name, phone, or contact email and name. Moxie API: GET /clients/search.

tools.name: moxie_create_client
tools.description: Create a client in the workspace. Only the name is required. Moxie API: POST /clients/create.

tools.name: moxie_update_client
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on an existing client (partial update; omitted fields stay as they are). The tool never sends a full replace. Moxie API: PATCH /clients/update.

tools.name: moxie_search_contacts
tools.description: List or search active contacts by email, first name, or last name. Omit query to list all. Moxie API: GET /contacts/search.

tools.name: moxie_search_projects
tools.description: List active projects, or the projects of one client by its exact name. Set includeArchived to add archived projects. Moxie API: GET /projects/search.

tools.name: moxie_list_project_notes
tools.description: List the private workspace notes of one project, newest first. Moxie API: GET /projects/notes/search.

tools.name: moxie_create_project_note
tools.description: Add a private note to a project. The note body is replaced only by moxie_update_project_note. Moxie API: POST /projects/notes/create.

tools.name: moxie_update_project_note
tools.description: Replace the body of an existing project note (not an append). Moxie API: PATCH /projects/notes/update.

tools.name: moxie_list_time_entries
tools.description: List completed time entries in a time window, with filters by user, client, project, task, or ticket. The maximum is 10,000 entries per call; narrow the window when a call returns that many. Moxie API: GET /timeWorked/list.

tools.name: moxie_list_open_invoices
tools.description: List outstanding (payable) invoices, optionally for one client by its exact name, or one invoice by id. Moxie API: GET /payableInvoices/search.

tools.name: moxie_create_expense
tools.description: Record an expense, optionally billable to a client with a markup. Moxie API: POST /expenses/create.

tools.name: moxie_search_opportunities
tools.description: Find pipeline opportunities by text, client, stage, or status. Archived records are included only by status ARCHIVED or includeArchived. Moxie API: GET /opportunities/search.

tools.name: moxie_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity in the pipeline. Moxie API: POST /opportunities/create.

tools.name: moxie_search_agreements
tools.description: List agreements in the workspace, or the agreements of one client. Read-only: Moxie does not allow agreement writes through the API. Moxie API: GET /agreements/search.

tools.name: moxie_get_account
tools.description: Get the supplier identity of the workspace (name, address, tax id, currency) for an accountId seen on invoices. Moxie API: GET /account/{accountId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: moxie_search_clients, moxie_search_contacts, moxie_list_time_entries · Private data: moxie_list_clients, moxie_search_clients, moxie_search_contacts, moxie_list_project_notes, moxie_create_project_note, moxie_create_expense, moxie_search_opportunities · Public sink: moxie_search_clients, moxie_create_client, moxie_search_contacts, moxie_create_project_note, moxie_create_expense, moxie_create_opportunity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: moxie_search_clients, moxie_search_contacts, moxie_list_time_entries · Private data: moxie_list_clients, moxie_search_clients, moxie_search_contacts, moxie_list_project_notes, moxie_create_project_note, moxie_create_expense, moxie_search_opportunities · Public sink: moxie_search_clients, moxie_create_client, moxie_search_contacts, moxie_create_project_note, moxie_create_expense, moxie_create_opportunity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
